name: Apache Hadoop
summary: A distributed storage and batch-compute platform that separates HDFS namespace metadata from replicated block storage and YARN resource arbitration from per-application execution.

features.name: NameNode and DataNode storage split
features.description: HDFS assigns namespace and block-placement metadata to the NameNode while DataNodes store and serve block replicas; clients transfer data through DataNodes rather than through the NameNode.
benefits: Separates metadata coordination from bulk data transfer
Supports large files and distributed storage across commodity nodes
costs: NameNode metadata is a central coordination boundary
Replication and failure detection add network and storage overhead

features.name: Replicated blocks with failure recovery
features.description: HDFS splits files into blocks, replicates them according to a configured factor, and uses DataNode heartbeats and block reports to detect failures and initiate re-replication.
benefits: Maintains availability across node or disk failures
Places replicas with rack awareness for reliability and bandwidth
costs: Replication consumes storage and write bandwidth
Failure detection and re-replication are eventually convergent

features.name: YARN resource arbitration
features.description: YARN separates cluster resource management in the ResourceManager and NodeManagers from per-application coordination in ApplicationMasters, with schedulers allocating resource containers.
benefits: Separates cluster-wide allocation from application-specific execution
Supports pluggable scheduling policies and resource reservations
costs: Applications must coordinate through an additional control layer
Allocation and monitoring state can diverge during failures

mathematical_views.question: How do namespace operations, block reports, heartbeats, and re-replication evolve durable HDFS file state?
assumptions: Blocks and replica locations are modeled explicitly
Failure detection is based on observed DataNode reports and heartbeats

mathematical_views.question: How are files and blocks connected to namespace metadata, DataNodes, racks, and client transfers?
assumptions: The NameNode metadata graph is authoritative for placement decisions
The view abstracts wire protocols and local disk layouts

mathematical_views.question: How do applications move from submission through ApplicationMaster negotiation to container execution?
assumptions: NodeManagers report execution and resource observations
